kind: Prospective method-specific scientific-value reassessment after material favorable evidence
trigger: stemTOC broad TCGA analysis includes SARC and its cell-cycle-inhibition construction reduces non-mitotic age confounding; automatic follow-through requires assessing this stronger method rather than inheriting epiTOC2 rate limitations.
before_outcomes: No numerical methylation values have been inspected. This reassessment is prospective for stemTOC, not a retrospective test substitution. Original question and controls are preserved.
one_concrete_question: Could the published 371-CpG stemTOC counter establish an interpretable EMC cumulative proliferative-history state, relative to fixed source-matched primary FFPE fusion-associated sarcoma controls, that would justify adding a mitotic-epigenetic measurement to future EMC molecular profiling?
controls: Unchanged all ten reference EMCs plus every authenticated newly relevant EMC condition; all 62 fixed primary FFPE SYSA/MLS/LGFMS/SEF controls from the original source selection. Case 21 remains a separately published condition with limited array linkage; ambiguous Cases 19/30 and other suitable identity-pending sources cannot be silently omitted. No value-selected control, new cluster or one-case rescue.
stronger_method_evidence: stemTOC uses population doublings in normal fibroblast, endothelial and smooth-muscle cells, with cell-cycle-inhibition comparisons; fetal-ground-state and broad TCGA analysis including SARC support transport plausibility. Its narrower 15-type tumor-cell-origin endpoint must not be confused with the full 32-type analysis.
age_distinction: Individual age is necessary for epiTOC2 rate R=TNSC/age. It is not mathematically required to compute a stemTOC cumulative score, and missing age alone does not defeat a descriptive cumulative contrast. Non-mitotic chronological-age effects are reduced by construction; cumulative division history can still differ by exposure duration and cellular composition.
strongest_alternative: A bulk cumulative score difference reflects tumor/stromal/immune cell-history weights, disease-specific epigenetic regulation, or slide/normalization rather than the EMC state of interest. Same supplier/date does not eliminate these alternatives.
defeat_rule: No standalone paper if a score only distinguishes established diagnostic classes, lacks an independently measured EMC state endpoint or independent comparable replication, or suitable relevant data remain unevaluated. A statistically separated novel descriptor alone would not establish added biological or clinical use.
actual_source_value_checks: No independently measured proliferation/state endpoint is released for the ten reference EMCs and the fixed 62 controls.

Six EMCs share one slide with one LGFMS control; another EMC shares a different slide with seven MLS controls; three EMCs lack the fixed supplier/date/slide comparator. Comparator histology is coupled to matching strata.
Tumor-content estimates exist but do not measure individual cell-type mitotic histories; original stemTOC authors explicitly retain this bulk-weighting limitation.
One published Case 21 has age 35 and mitotic activity >5/10 HPF. It is not independent validation across an EMC cohort, and a score in this previously described case would remain exploratory.
No exact shared-probe, preprocessing or counter-formula transport check has been performed on the actual matrix. Public values, identity/condition mappings and broader coverage remain pending.
decision: SHELVE the useful standalone state contrast after method-specific reassessment. This is a value/comparability decision, not proof that the stronger counter cannot be computed or used in future EMC research.
matrix_stage: No 5.29 GB download or stream; larger staging would be justified only if an interpretable useful contrast survives. Numerical matrices remain pending accessible analysis, not scientifically unsuitable by size.
reopen: Case-linked orthogonal EMC mitotic/state observations or a useful independently replicated biological contrast with comparable controls and mixture/source protection; exact probe/formula/preprocessing checks and complete public EMC coverage before promotion.
scientific_followthrough: Favorable methodological evidence retained; validity and scientific value considered separately. No claim of a new finding, low proliferation, intrinsic clock invalidity or public-evidence exhaustion.
